description: Fabric mod: PvP arenas on demand, each in a dimension of its own

mods.name: PvP Dimensions
mods.description: Arenas on demand: a dimension of its own for a fight, started from a menu, entered by invite or through a nearby portal frame, gone when the game is over

releases.notes:
- Every mod's page in the mod menu has Play demo, where the mod ships one.
- Spies: standing up from a seat no longer leaves an armour stand behind every time.
- Big arenas don't stall the server when they start, drop their walls, count a takeover or lay a saved terrain.
- Waves sent early stop at 150 mobs standing, and the trap list forgets blocks that are gone.
- The scoreboard, the weather and endless blocks send only what changed.
- An arena's mobs and golems get their goals once, and smaller per-tick costs trimmed.
- An arena's game state goes with the server when it stops, not into the next world opened.
- Spies: a seat brought back with a player who logged out sitting is taken away when they stand.
- A takeover goal that comes back mid-count starts its count afresh, and a wave held for its players still stops at 150 standing.

releases.notes:
- Mod demos: each mod with one has a short level to play that shows what it does. New players are asked once if they'd like to try them, and everyone is asked when a new one arrives.
- /pvp demos lists them, ticked once played. Play them in any order, straight from one to the next; your own things wait at home until you're done.
- With Spawn Lock, nobody held at the spawn goes into an arena or a demo, and someone jailed from inside an arena is let out where they were before it.
- Arenas can't be joined from Minicraft's workshop: step back out to the bench first, so your own things stay with you.

releases.notes:
- A fourth game mode, custom: survival with the powers a preset gives it. Flying, still hurt as in survival; and endless blocks, a list of blocks that putting down never uses up.
- An arena with endless blocks keeps everything apart and lets nothing out, as creative does. Custom can be switched to partway through, like any other mode.

releases.notes:
- Cops and robbers, for two teams: the cops tag robbers into an iron-barred jail that any free robber can spring, while the robbers steal gold from the cops' vault and bank it in their hideout.
- In Guess who, ringing your bell with one suspect left standing accuses it.
- Guess who has many more suspects: zombies and skeletons (in leather caps against the sun), piglins, wardens, dolphins, camels and more, every baby as a suspect of its own, ores, Nether and End blocks, beacons and cakes, and items floating over their squares, from a diamond or a trident to water and lava in their buckets; and our other mods' blocks, items, bears and baby skeletons when those mods are on the server.
